open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA) Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Historical fencing practitioners who train weekly, value historical authenticity, and want gear/clothing referencing 15th-century fight books (e.g., Lichtenauer, Fiore dei Liberi).
product_angles: Vintage vector apparel designs featuring clean vector traces of medieval manual woodcuts (Redbubble)
Vinyl stickers with sword fighting inside jokes and terminology (e.g., 'Zwerchhau solves everything')

proposals.name: Godot Engine UI Kits & Asset Packs
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers shifting from Unity/Unreal to Godot who need drag-and-drop UI configurations, theme files, and stylized UI icon sheets to speed up prototyping.
product_angles: Godot 4 GUI Theme files with pre-configured custom control nodes
Cyberpunk / Sci-Fi vector UI asset pack (SVG & PNG slices)
Retro RPG pixel-art UI components and buttons
proposals.first_test_product: Godot 4 Dark Fantasy UI Theme & Vector Icons

proposals.name: Amateur Radio (HAM) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Older tech hobbyists and emergency prep advocates who build radio rigs, collect QSL confirmation cards, and take pride in their technical call signs.
product_angles: Minimalist & Retro QSL Card Templates (Digital downloads for self-printing)
Amateur Radio Logbook for contesting and DX tracking (KDP)
Patent art posters of historic radio keys and vacuum tubes (Redbubble)

proposals.name: Ortholinear & Split Mechanical Keyboard Builders
proposals.buyer_persona: Software engineers and writers obsessed with ergonomics, custom firmware (QMK/VIAL), and high-end desk aesthetics.
product_angles: Ortholinear keyboard layout cheat-sheet desk mats (Redbubble/POD)
3D printable travel cases for Corne / Lily58 split keyboards (STL on Cults3D)
Minimalist vector stickers featuring keycap legend designs
proposals.first_test_product: Corne Keyboard Parametric 3D Printable Travel Case (Cults3D)

proposals.name: Clinical Research Coordinators (CRC) & Monitors (CRA)
proposals.buyer_persona: Stressed medical research professionals who manage clinical trials, deal with endless FDA/EMA paperwork, and rely heavily on caffeine and dark humor.
product_angles: Mugs and stickers with GCP (Good Clinical Practice) & protocol deviation jokes
Digital planner templates optimized for tracking multiple clinical sites

proposals.name: Active Mycology & Mushroom Cultivators
proposals.buyer_persona: Home scientists and gourmet mushroom growers who need strict sterile logs, agar plates tracking, and substrate recipe ratios.
product_angles: Sterile Mycology Lab Logbook for spore-to-agar-to-grain tracking (KDP)
Spore print card templates and printable liquid culture labels
Aesthetic vintage mushroom illustration t-shirts with scientific nomenclature (Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: Mycology Lab Log & Inoculation Record Book (KDP)
